conventions.convention: Codes include finite rational polygonal drawing certificates, coherent orientations and branch pairings tracing one circle. Under-arcs are cut only at underpasses; a crossing-free circle has one under-arc.
A positive meridian bounds a normal disk whose orientation, preceded by the oriented knot tangent, gives the ambient orientation.
The positive in-plane over-normal points from source s to target t. With common upper-collar basing paths, m_t = m_o⁻¹ m_s m_o, independently of the understrand direction.
The crossing-free Euclidean complement has homotopy type S¹ ∨ S²; passage to the three-sphere complement preserves the fundamental group, rather than the full homotopy type.
Simultaneously prepending the same based loop to all access paths conjugates every meridian image by the same element.

load_bearing.statement: For a smooth oriented knot with a valid finite planar diagram code and designated starting under-arc, the constructor terminates and returns one positive-meridian generator per under-arc and one conjugacy relator per crossing. The generator-to-based-positive-meridian homomorphism is an isomorphism onto π₁(S³ ∖ K,b), using the common upper-collar paths.

For c>0 and the specified product-cap and product-tube neighborhood, the exterior strongly deformation retracts onto a subspace covered by a free-meridian region U and pairwise disjoint contractible crossing pieces V_i, with annular overlaps U ∩ V_i. For c=0 the Euclidean complement has homotopy type S¹ ∨ S², with positive meridian generating its infinite cyclic fundamental group. The punctured chosen tube retracts radially to its boundary.

With the common upper-collar basing paths, the based positive meridians satisfy m_t = m_o⁻¹ m_s m_o, where the positive over-normal points from source s to target t. This equation is independent of the understrand direction.

A finite planar code contains the finite incidence, cyclic-order, opposite-branch pairing, orientation and over/under data, together with a rational polygonal plane-drawing certificate satisfying the stated intersection, transversality and one-component conditions.
For a compact smooth knot K ⊂ R³ and b ∈ R³ ∖ K, inclusion R³ ∖ K → S³ ∖ K induces an isomorphism on fundamental groups at b.

The displayed square and integer figure-eight drawings are valid oriented codes. The figure-eight positive-meridian relations are x₁x₂=x₃x₁, x₁x₄=x₄x₂, x₃x₂=x₂x₄ and x₃x₄=x₁x₃; the fourth follows from the first three. Starting on x₁, underpasses occur at R₂,R₁,R₃,R₄, and self-writhe is zero.
